issues.description: The problem statement and the template declare Course.getAverageRating() to return a Double, but the solution implementation defines getAverageRating() returning Float. This type mismatch across artifacts is structural and may confuse students about the expected return type and how to implement the method.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the return type across all artifacts. Update the solution implementation of getAverageRating() to return Double (change the signature to -> Double and compute using Double casts), or alternatively change the problem statement and template to consistently require Float. Prefer changing the solution to Double to match the existing problem statement and template.
